notablePrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {U/B}.
Kels triggers, and The Watcher in the Water's second ability triggers if the sacrificed creature was a Tentacle.
Resolve the Watcher in the Water trigger, if applicable, untapping up to one Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Kels trigger, causing you to pay {U/B} to draw a card.
The Watcher in the Water's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
